title: The Promotion Staircase

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: I bought a Hi and put three hats on it. Same-day expert.
directions: [board: Pip has opened a hat shop beside the board. A sign reads SAME-DAY EXPERTS. Three hats wobble in a stack on the new Hi at C3. The top one slides off and rolls under the table.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Those are hats. That is a costume.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: A real hat is bought in the Place step. One hat. Never on the day you arrive.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: C three again. Yesterday's Hi moved on. Today a new one arrived there.
directions: [board: C three. Yesterday's Hi has walked on. A new Hi stands there with a paper tag.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Filed. Underneath: the star-shaped delivery zone. Overruled by the box.
directions: [card: PIP'S AMENDMENTS (PENDING). Click files THREE HATS AT ONCE and lifts out the card underneath.]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Fire climbs a staircase. The Hi, then the Hono, then the Kagari.
directions: [card: FIRE STAIRCASE: the Hi costs 2 · the Hono costs 6 · the Kagari costs 12]

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Small fire. Then flame. Then watch-fire.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: A promotion happens in the Place step. It costs crystals, not actions.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: One step up, in your own element, once per piece per turn.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Watch one. A Sjor costs four crystals. A Straumr costs eight.
directions: [board: DEMO. Place phase. Bank 4. A White Sjor on a plain square, tagged HERE BEFORE THIS TURN, not yet promoted.] [card: WATER STAIRCASE: the Sjor costs 4 · the Straumr costs 8]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Eight take away four leaves four.
directions: [sfx: shop chime] [board: four crystals leave the bank. The Sjor grows into a Straumr. Bank ticks 4 to 0.]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Pay the gap. One step up.
lines.performanceNote: Carefully enunciate Pay THE gap. Say pay, not pave. A small space between pay and the. Do not add words.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Two hats above a Hi. Never three. No secret fourth-floor elevator.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: A piece that arrived this turn cannot climb today. It waits until next turn.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: D four: here before this turn. C three: arrived today.
directions: [board: back to the board. Place phase. Bank 4. A White Hi on D4 wearing a paper tag HERE BEFORE THIS TURN. A White Hi on C3 wearing a paper tag ARRIVED TODAY.] [card: THIS PROMOTION COSTS 4]

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Our bank has four crystals. This promotion costs four.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Which Hi can climb the staircase right now?

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: One of them is still wearing today's tag. I think that decides it.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: There is no rush on this one. Watch it with me if you would rather.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: The hat settled on the one that was already here. Pip named the tag first.
directions: [board: a hat floats over the C3 Hi. Its ARRIVED TODAY tag lights up, and the hat lifts away. It settles on the D4 Hi, which grows into a Hono. Bank ticks 4 to 0.] [sfx: shop chime]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Arrival: today. Promotion: not today.

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: New today. It may walk, hit and collect. It may not climb.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Then my sign is wrong. New policy. Hats fit the ones who were already here.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: Was that the best four crystals I ever spent?

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: That is a different count. Today we only proved it was allowed.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Metal climbs the same way. The Inyan, the Mazask, the Tanka.
directions: [board: Pip crosses out the shop sign and letters NEXT-DAY EXPERTS.]
[card: EVIDENCE. Proves: who may promote, and the price. Not checked: whether four crystals were better spent elsewhere.]
[card: METAL LADDER: the Inyan costs 5 · the Mazask costs 9 · the Tanka costs 17]

lines.speaker: CLICK
lines.text: Stone. Wall. Great.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Slip a paper strip under each piece with the turn it arrived.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: For every element, tier one to tier two costs four crystals. Tier two to tier three costs eight. A promoted piece can act immediately. There is no fourth tier.

supplement.title: The same promotion prices for all six elements
supplement.body:
T1 → T2: pay 4
T2 → T3: pay 8
One step per piece per turn. Never on its purchase turn.
Promoted pieces act immediately. T3 is the top.

lines.speaker: PIP
lines.text: The two spare hats go in a box. For pieces that were already here yesterday.

lines.speaker: COACH
lines.text: Stop here whenever you like. Next time: who sends our army a bill?
